name: Meridian
tagline: Map-first Southeast Asia travel planner for travellers departing from Singapore
status: V1 — working end to end. Twelve destinations including Malaysia, five loyalty programmes, Xiaohongshu-only guide import with text + image analysis. No live data.
productThesis: An interactive geographic decision-making tool that helps Singapore-based travellers decide where to go, where to stay, what to do, and how to arrange those places into an efficient trip. The map is the product; the itinerary is built around the map.

repository.styling: Tailwind CSS 3 with CSS custom properties as design tokens
repository.state: Zustand with persist middleware (localStorage), manual hydration

primaryTileHost.cost: free, no API key, CORS open

fallbackTileHost.cost: free, no API key, no limits

mapEngine.whyVectorNotRaster: Raster tiles bake labels into pixels. Vector tiles allow cutting the label set to country/region/city/town, forcing English, and applying the product's own palette.
mapEngine.labelPolicy: No villages, suburbs, hamlets, POIs, road names, house numbers or waterway names. Base city labels start at zoom 6.
mapEngine.knownConstraint: MapLibre's web worker is resolved via import.meta.url, which a bundler cannot follow. scripts/vendor-maplibre-worker.mjs vendors it into public/ before dev and build.

routing.primary: OSRM (real road geometry, road distance, drive duration)
routing.fallback: Geodesic estimator with a documented speed model
routing.abstraction: lib/routing — distance and travel time are separate fields and never conflated

dataScope.note: Twelve destinations, all reference tier. Malaysia (Penang, Kuala Lumpur) added; Chinese coverage is complete across every destination, with nameZh omitted only where a name has no form in real Chinese use.

correctionsFoundDuringVerification: Bali has only five Hilton-branded hotels; a DoubleTree in the first draft does not exist and was removed
Siem Reap's airport code is SAI, not REP (REP closed October 2023)
Phnom Penh moved to Techo International (KTI) in September 2025
El Nido's IATA code is ENI; LIO is only the local airstrip name
Le Meridien Angkor is closed but still marketed as open by the brand
Four Points by Sheraton Palawan is in Sabang, ~2 hours from Puerto Princesa city

Four Points by Sheraton Bali, Ungasan was in the product twice, under two ids and two Marriott property codes (DPSFG and DPSFP). Only DPSFG is real; the duplicate is deleted, and the validator now fails on two hotels plotted within 150 m of each other in the same destination
bugsFoundByTesting: Fixed region bounds excluded Bali, leaving a destination off-screen — bounds are now derived from the data
minZoom clamped the mobile fit and pushed the Singapore origin off the left edge
Marker z-index escaped the map stacking context and floated above the mobile bottom sheet
A 3.5% fill on inactive areas compounded across 10+ overlapping areas into a grey veil over the planning map
Area labels repeated 4-5 times because they were placed from large polygons instead of a one-point-per-area source
MapLibre's worker failed to load under the bundler, leaving a blank canvas with no error
knownLimitations: Five loyalty programmes, not every programme: Accor Live Limitless and Wyndham Rewards are absent rather than half-populated.
Penang has no open Hyatt, so its STAY filter offers four programmes; Boracay has one loyalty hotel and Palawan one. These are verified ceilings.
32 places are approximate or unlocatable after the coordinate audit.
Imported guides, saved places and images live in one browser; there are no accounts.
The new Malaysian and expanded records carry no licensed photography and fall back to the no-photograph state.
No prices anywhere — hotel cost is a positioning tier with its basis displayed.

documents.dossierLines: PROCESS.md documents every iteration: the destination redesign, the origin model, the Xiaohongshu import, and the ten-destination data expansion.

destinationExperience.mapDiscipline: one layer per tab; the camera re-frames per tab
destinationExperience.areas: six headline regions with authored taglines, drawn as native two-line map labels

imagery.architecture: lib/images — components request by (entityKind, entityId), never construct a URL
imagery.honestyMechanism: subject: subject|area|category — a hotel showing its beach is disclosed as an area photo
imagery.regenerate: npm run images:resolve && npm run images:download

transport.abstraction: TransportLeg with mode, rationale, alternatives, distance, duration, geometry, source, confidence, multimodal

routingProviders.serverProxy: app/api/route/route.ts — API keys never reach the browser

transport.recommendation: lib/transport/recommend.ts — separate from routing; states its reasoning in the UI
transport.fabricationPolicy: a route result cannot carry a number unless a provider produced one; unanswered legs render as "Route unavailable"
transport.waterCrossings: modelled as curated data, so Ubud to Nusa Penida renders as a two-mode leg via Sanur Harbour

photography.provider: lib/images — components ask by (entityKind, entityId) and never hold a URL
photography.licencePolicy: commercial use only — CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 and public domain. No NC, no ND.
photography.attribution: author, licence and source page ship on every image and render on cards and detail views
photography.hotelRule: a hotel photo is used only if the file title names the property AND the right part of Bali, or the file sits in the property's own Commons category. A hotel with no verified photography has no entry and shows "No property photography available" — it never borrows its area photo.
photography.linkChecked: every candidate is fetched before it is written into the manifest; sources that have since been deleted are dropped rather than shipped as a 404
photography.signagePolicy: Photographs of a hotel's name on a wall are excluded: correctly licensed and provably of the property, but not property photography. The generator logs each exclusion.
photography.generatorIdCheck: npm run validate:data fails if any manifest key is not a real entity, or if the generator's own id list names something the dataset does not contain

travelZones.what: approximate travel extents derived from each area's own mapped hotels and places
travelZones.geometry: convex hull of the area content, offset outward, smoothed
travelZones.rendering: tinted wash + fine dashed edge (dashed = approximate). Inserted below the basemap water layer so zones clip to land.
travelZones.whyNotCircles: a radial envelope around a centroid degenerates into a circle when content is sparse, which is exactly the crude radius appearance this replaced
travelZones.hierarchy: EXPLORE draws one scope at a time (nine stay bases OR six day-trip zones), shared with the panel through the UI store

transportLegs.format: mode · estimated duration · distance, then rationale, then source badge
transportLegs.sourceBadge: names the routing engine, or says "No route data"
transportLegs.traffic: not modelled — measured legs are labelled free-flow estimates
transportLegs.unavailable: legs with no route data show no duration at all and the day clock is marked approx

languages.architecture: lib/i18n — a 546-key catalogue. zhCN is authored first; en is typed as Record<keyof typeof zhCN, string>, so a missing translation is a compile error.
languages.properNouns: Stored twice. nameZh sits beside the canonical name and both are shown, because a traveller reads 乌鲁瓦图神庙 and then types "Uluwatu Temple" into Grab. nameZh is omitted where no Chinese name is genuinely in use (29 of 145 Bali places).
languages.copyStyle: Written as Chinese, not translated from the English. Different text for the same reader, shorter.
languages.whereTheLocaleLives: The persisted UI store, not a cookie — the site is statically exported and must not read request state.
languages.overlay: lib/data/zh/bali-zh.ts. Chinese copy is merged by the registry so the hand-verified geography files are never touched by a translation pass.

research.purpose: Turn a Xiaohongshu post — its text AND its images — into structured places on the traveller's map, and from there into an itinerary.
research.coreProductMoment: 把这篇文章直接变成一张可编辑的旅行地图。

supportedSources.whyOneValue: SocialPlatform is a ONE-value union on purpose. A nine-value union is a standing invitation for a second platform to arrive by accident; a one-value union makes the next source a deliberate change to the union, a provider and a copy pass.
supportedSources.refusalUx: A link to another platform is refused by name: 这看起来不是小红书链接。V1 只支持小红书…

retrieval.approach: A single polite request to an approved retrieval provider, server-side, only when XIAOHONGSHU_RETRIEVAL_ENDPOINT is configured.
never: solve or bypass a CAPTCHA or signature
rotate user agents, proxies or fingerprints
retrieval.refusalIsFinal: A provider refusal is reported as `unavailable` and is not retried. The platform said no; the traveller keeps working by pasting text or uploading screenshots.
retrieval.imageRelay: GET /api/import/xiaohongshu/image — one url per request, allowlisted CDN hosts, 8MB ceiling, image-only content type, private no-store. It is a relay, not an open proxy.
retrieval.fallback: 暂时无法直接读取这篇小红书。你仍然可以上传/粘贴内容继续整理。
retrieval.fallbackIsOfflineByDefault: NEXT_PUBLIC_XHS_RETRIEVAL defaults to 0, so with no provider configured the panel shows the fallback immediately instead of making a request guaranteed to 404.

analysis.abstraction: lib/research/analyzer.ts — one GuideAnalyzer interface, two implementations, identical result shape

providers.heuristic: Default. Browser. No key. Reads the text with the rule-based extractor; marks images `unsupported` and says so rather than guessing from a filename.
providers.multimodal: Server, via /api/analyze-guide. Reads text plus downscaled images, four per batch. OpenAI-compatible endpoints, OpenAI or Anthropic.

analysis.notOcrOnly: The prompt reads visible text, branding and scene, and relates a sequence of frames to the post text.
analysis.merging: mergeFindings collapses detections of the same place across text and images into ONE candidate with detectedFromText and the union of detectedFromImageIds (§24). Different spellings are left separate — that judgement belongs to the matcher, which has the corpus and the alias table.
analysis.lowConfidence: An image-only finding below IMAGE_PROPOSAL_FLOOR (0.6) is NOT turned into a place candidate. The image goes to the unassigned tray instead, where it reads as a question rather than an answer (§26).

placeResolution.why: Each step is strictly more expensive and less trustworthy than the one before, so the order is correctness rather than convenience.
placeResolution.modelNeverSuppliesCoordinates: Stated in the system prompt, absent from the pipeline's types, and visible in the UI. A model that has never seen Bali cannot place a beach club, and a plausible wrong latitude would corrupt an itinerary with a stop that does not exist.
placeResolution.externalHitIsAQuestion: An external hit is offered, never auto-accepted. Confirming one saves a UserPlaceSubmission the traveller owns, pending review — because 'a map search found this name' and 'Meridian knows this place' are different claims.
placeResolution.manualPin: The traveller clicks the map; the coordinate is theirs. The place is a UserPlaceSubmission, never canonical.

imageAssignment.humanWins: A re-analysis only ever replaces `suggested` rows, so a user correction survives it (§33).
imageAssignment.oneImageOnePlace: Reassigning MOVES an image rather than copying it, so a picture cannot render under two cards or make the unassigned count lie.
imageAssignment.unassignedTray: 未分配图片 — every image attached to no place, tappable to attach, create from, or leave for later (§17).
imageAssignment.fromImage: 「这张图是什么地方？」 → attach to a known place, search Meridian, or create a place with a map-pinned coordinate (§18).

images.storage: IndexedDB (meridian.images.v1), never localStorage: one base64 screenshot would blow the ~5MB quota and take the traveller's itinerary down with it.

threeSizes.thumb: 320px, lists only — a review screen with twenty cards must not decode twenty 1600px bitmaps
threeSizes.analysis: 1024px, generated on demand and never persisted; sized so signage survives the downscale

images.dedupe: SHA-256 of the STORED bytes, so re-uploading the same screenshot costs one record and one set of bytes.
images.deletedWithTheImport: deleteImport purges the text, candidates, analyses, assignments AND the image bytes.

privacy.boundary: An imported image is `private_import`, written by the only function that can create an image record — buildImageRecord in lib/research/image-rules.ts — which has no parameter for visibility.
privacy.neverPublic: No code path promotes an imported picture to canonical photography, hotel gallery or community image (§20).
privacy.futureContribution: `user_contributed` exists for §21's own-photo-with-consent flow and is unreachable from every import path.
privacy.savedPlaceSplit: A saved place shows canonical photography and, under a separate heading, 来自你的攻略（只有你能看到） (§22, §23).
privacy.copyright: No creator text or imagery is republished. At most one short sentence is quoted as the reason a name was extracted.

research.apiKeySecurity: No browser-side module reads an API key, asserted by a test that reads the sources. Every secret is read in a route handler, and on the static GitHub Pages build none of those routes are deployed.

coordinateSourcing.method: scripts/geocode-pois.mjs resolves placeholder coordinates against Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) and records the OSM element in coordNote.
coordinateSourcing.why: The datasets were authored by name. Asking a language model for latitudes produces plausible numbers that are wrong often enough to matter.
coordinateSourcing.rejected: Anything outside Bali, or more than 15 km from the area it claims to be in, is rejected and reported for a human.
coordinateSourcing.unresolved: Six places are not in OSM. They keep confidence "demo" and are excluded from the map and from itineraries; their cards say 位置未核实.

origins.model: OriginCity is a first-class entity with a list of airports. One city is not one airport: Shanghai has PVG and SHA, Beijing PEK and PKX, Chengdu CTU and TFU, Bangkok BKK and DMK.
origins.coordinates: All 16 airports and every city centre resolved against OpenStreetMap via Nominatim; scripts/verify-origins.mjs re-checks the dataset.
origins.chinaIsAnOriginMarket: China is an origin market only. There are no Chinese destinations, deliberately — mixing the two would turn a focused origin upgrade into an unbounded content project.
origins.persistence: Its own store (lib/store/origin-store.ts) with its own storage key, because "I live in Guangzhou" belongs to a person, not to a trip. Replacing localStorage with a user profile touches one file.
origins.nearbyAirports: nearbyOriginIds is populated and surfaced as a hint; nothing acts on it yet. Architecture for 考虑附近机场 without the optimisation.

connections.abstraction: OriginDestinationConnection. Whether a route is non-stop is a property of an (origin, destination) PAIR, not of the destination airport.
connections.directAvailable: boolean | null, and null means UNKNOWN — not "no". A pair with no record renders 航班信息待确认 and shows no duration at all.
connections.harvestedFromDestinationData: Singapore's connections are extracted at load from the destination files, keeping the cited sources (airline timetables, news reports, checked block times) attached to the data they describe.
connections.weekendSuitability: Curated per pair, never derived from distance. Singapore → Bali is not-ideal; Bangkok → Siem Reap is good.
connections.refresh: Every record carries source and verifiedAt so it can be re-checked. Nothing refreshes automatically yet.

tripModel.originCityId: Trips store where they depart from.
tripModel.migration: A zustand version-1 migration stamps singapore on trips saved before origins existed, plus a hydrate backstop for payloads with no version field. Days, items and dates are untouched.

localizedArrays: bestFor, weakFor and tags carry positionally-aligned Chinese variants. The validator checks alignment, because pickList falls back per index and a mismatch degrades into a half-Chinese line that reads as a bug.

loyaltyProgrammes.markerSystem: Five programmes, five head shapes and five letters (M rounded square, H circle, I hexagon, Y diamond, G shield). Colour is never the only differentiator.
loyaltyProgrammes.ghaIsAnAlliance: GHA DISCOVERY is a consortium, not a hotel company: its members are independently owned brands sharing one loyalty scheme. Labelled 联盟 in the filter row.

coordinateAudit.result: 652 coordinates, 0 failures, 29 expected cross-kind coincidences, 8 deliberately unlocatable
coordinateAudit.bugItFound: 73 of Bali 145 places shared a coordinate with another record, most labelled "verified" and carrying a coordNote that named the OTHER venue. Fixed via 73 audited corrections in lib/data/destinations/extra/coord-corrections.ts.
coordinateAudit.permanentGuard: validate-data.ts now fails on any two same-kind records sharing a coordinate.
